fit_reason: Whole car (2009 Toyota Venza) listed by a private owner.
findings: Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on the front, most visible on the driver-side headlight
Paint looks somewhat flat and dull on the hood and front bumper
Dusty, dirty film on the rear bumper and lower liftgate
Light scuffs on the front bumper cover
Interior only visible through the windows, not enough to judge
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2009 Venza. The headlights look hazy and yellowed in the photos, and the paint on the hood and rear bumper looks a bit dull and dusty. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a wash, polish and wax, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
